program_text='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    background = common[0]
    line_color = common[1]

    # A clearly dominant row/column of the secondary background color marks
    # the intersections of the encoded matrix.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) >= 0.65 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65 * h]

    # In the alternate encoding, matrix entries are the pixels using colors
    # outside the two-color patterned background.
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v not in common for v in grid[r])]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in common for r in range(h))]

    matrix = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(matrix) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for c in range(len(matrix[0]) - 1):
            patch = [matrix[r][c], matrix[r][c + 1], matrix[r + 1][c], matrix[r + 1][c + 1]]
            value = patch[0]
            out_row.append(value if value not in common and all(x == value for x in patch) else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''

new_program='''from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    background = common[0]

    active_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v not in common for v in grid[r])]
    active_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in common for r in range(h))]

    def complete_axis(indices):
        if len(indices) < 2:
            return indices
        step = reduce(gcd, (b - a for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:])))
        if step == 0:
            return indices
        return list(range(indices[0], indices[-1] + 1, step))

    rows = complete_axis(active_rows)
    cols = complete_axis(active_cols)
    matrix = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(matrix) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for c in range(len(matrix[0]) - 1):
            patch = [matrix[r][c], matrix[r][c + 1], matrix[r + 1][c], matrix[r + 1][c + 1]]
            value = patch[0]
            out_row.append(value if value not in common and all(x == value for x in patch) else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''
